comments.text:
Implement RoutingPage Vizia view showing part output assignments, FX routing, and Comp+EQ routing.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.13 (MixerPage — reuses strip styling)

THREE SECTIONS:
1. Part Routing Grid: 16 columns showing part number, tone type badge, tone name, output assign dropdown (A/B/C/D/1-8), FX send indicators
2. Effects Routing: Chorus type + output select, Reverb type + output assign (read-only display)
3. Drum Comp+EQ Routing: 6 unit output assign dropdowns (conditional on drumCompEq.enabled)
- Surround override banner when surround is active

REFERENCE:
- web/src/RoutingPage.tsx: complete React implementation
- web/src/RoutingPage.module.css: styling
- docs/design/output-routing.md: design document with signal flow diagram

title: VST/Vizia: implement RoutingPage with part output assign grid
